name: uses object identity for empty and acyclic inputs
input: empty heads, an acyclic Y shape, and equal-valued distinct nodes
test:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

assert intersect(None, Node(1)) is False
shared = Node(9)
shared.next = Node(10)
left = Node(1)
left.next = shared
right = Node(2)
right.next = Node(3)
right.next.next = shared
assert intersect(left, right) is True
assert intersect(Node(7), Node(7)) is False
assert intersect(shared, shared) is True

name: rejects one-cycle and disjoint-cycle cases
input: one cyclic chain paired with an acyclic chain, then two separate loops
test:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

loop = Node('loop')
loop.next = loop
plain = Node('plain')
assert intersect(loop, plain) is False
a = Node('a')
b = Node('b')
a.next = b
b.next = a
c = Node('c')
d = Node('d')
c.next = d
d.next = c
assert intersect(a, c) is False

name: finds shared cycles with same or different entries
input: two paths entering a common cycle at different nodes and two paths sharing a prefix before a loop
test:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

x = Node('x')
y = Node('y')
z = Node('z')
x.next = y
y.next = z
z.next = x
first = Node('first')
first.next = x
second = Node('second')
second.next = y
assert intersect(first, second) is True
entry = Node('entry')
entry.next = entry
shared_prefix = Node('shared')
shared_prefix.next = entry
left = Node('left')
left.next = shared_prefix
right = Node('right')
right.next = shared_prefix
assert intersect(left, right) is True
